judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Breathless exclamation-heavy pleas, a missing comma in the run-on, the odd 'he'll be destroyed', and the near-duplicate 'token(s) of my appreciation' thank-yous have the unedited, plain feel of Nox's side quests; the 'maidens kidnapped by Ogres' setup is generic enough that a pastiche could produce it.
